# Three Seeds

> Tax, controller, and Part Time CFO support for businesses where cash moves on
> an uneven schedule. Run by Robert "Bobby" Zinda from Central Wisconsin, working with
> owners nationwide, fully remote.

Three Seeds works with owner-led businesses whose revenue is healthy but whose
cash arrives on a timetable that does not match when the bills come due:
seasonal operators, contractors carrying retainage, and inventory-heavy
distributors. The work is cash flow forecasting, tax planning, and controller
support, built on the client's own books.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.threeseeds.io/): What Three Seeds does and the three kinds of cash timing problems it solves.
- [Tax services](https://www.threeseeds.io/tax-services): Business and owner tax returns, year-round tax planning, entity structure and owner compensation, estimated payments sized to uneven income, and sales and payroll tax filings. Explains the difference between tax preparation and tax planning, and includes a nine-question FAQ.
- [Seasonal business tax guide](https://www.threeseeds.io/seasonal-businesses): The seasonal deep dive. Customer deposits and tax timing, sales tax on tours and rentals, seasonal worker classification, estimated taxes on uneven income, year-end equipment purchases, 1099-K reconciliation, and off-season runway. Includes a seasonal tax calendar and an eight-question FAQ.
- [Cash flow services](https://www.threeseeds.io/services): The three service tiers, bookkeeping, controller, and Part Time CFO, plus a one-time Financial Discovery engagement.
- [Case studies](https://www.threeseeds.io/case-studies): Two detailed engagements, a finance command system for a subscription platform and a rebuilt $10M+ fixed-asset register, plus the industries served: SaaS, wellness, agriculture, travel, oil and gas, and consumer lending.
- [About](https://www.threeseeds.io/about): Robert Zinda, the founder, and where the Three Seeds name comes from.
- [Contact](https://www.threeseeds.io/contact): Free 30-minute discovery call. Month to month, no contracts.

## Notes

- Service area is the entire United States. The practice is fully remote.
- Guidance published on this site is general information, not advice for a specific situation.
